title: Install the KRN App on the pilot repository so adopt --verify reads it
body:
Outcome: the KRN GitHub App (krn-works-delivery) is installed on krn-works/seo-audit-harness so `krn adopt /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/pilot/lead --verify` reads the required check and auto-merge instead of exiting 67 "GitHub App not installed".
Why: S27 proof run 2026-11-16 printed duplicate-ci: 0 and then exit 67; the pilot's remote verdict cannot be read. Installing an App is an operator grant (credentials), not lead work.
Also: the pilot's .agents/standards.json uses an old record type and adopt cannot compare it; after the App install run `krn adopt <pilot> --refresh` or migrate the records.
Proof: `bin/krn adopt /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/pilot/lead --verify` exits 0 or 1 naming gaps, never 67.
